concept.title: Countdown twirl, beige first
concept.hook: Aath din bache hain Diwali ke, aur sawaal ek hi hai: beige ya blue?
concept.voiceoverScript: Diwali se pehle sirf aath din, aur closet bilkul khaali lag raha tha. Phir online yeh set mila, aur ab mood hi alag hai. Yeh thread work dekho, sharare ka bhi. Organza itna halka hai, pehen ke pata nahi chalta. Warm undertones ho, toh raat ke liye yeh beige perfect hai. Aur subah ke liye light blue georgette Anarkali. Yoke pur embellishment, pants pur gota. Cool undertones ho toh yeh tumhara colour hai.

scenes.visualPrompt: A living room corner at dusk decorated for Diwali, clay diyas glowing along a low wooden shelf, marigold garlands on the wall, warm amber lamplight mixed with flickering diya glow, intimate festive mood. She wears a beige organza sleeveless straight kurta with a scoop neck and ethnic motif thread-work embroidery, above-knee length, with a matching embroidered beige organza sharara and a sheer embroidered beige organza dupatta with tassel borders. She spins into frame mid-twirl, the dupatta and sharara floating out, then stops facing the camera and laughs. Medium full-length framing at eye level.
scenes.dialogue: Diwali se pehle sirf aath din, aur closet bilkul khaali lag raha tha. Phir online yeh set mila, aur ab mood hi alag hai.

scenes.visualPrompt: The same living room corner at dusk decorated for Diwali, clay diyas glowing along a low wooden shelf, marigold garlands on the wall, warm amber lamplight mixed with flickering diya glow, intimate festive mood. She wears the same beige organza sleeveless scoop-neck thread-work kurta, embroidered beige organza sharara and sheer tasselled beige organza dupatta. She steps closer to the camera, runs her fingers over the embroidery on the kurta, then lifts a fold of the sharara to show the thread work, the sheer organza catching the warm light. scenes.dialogue: Yeh thread work dekho, sharare ka bhi. Organza itna halka hai, pehen ke pata nahi chalta. Warm undertones ho, toh raat ke liye yeh beige perfect hai.

scenes.visualPrompt: The same living room corner at dusk decorated for Diwali, clay diyas glowing along a low wooden shelf, marigold garlands on the wall, warm amber lamplight mixed with flickering diya glow, intimate festive mood. She now wears a light blue georgette sleeveless strappy flared Anarkali kurta with a round neck, an embellished yoke and sheer floaty flares, with matching light blue pants trimmed with gota. She touches the embellished yoke, sways so the flares drift, then points down at the gota trim on the pants and smiles at the camera. Medium full-length framing at eye level.
scenes.dialogue: Aur subah ke liye light blue georgette Anarkali. Yoke pur embellishment, pants pur gota. Cool undertones ho toh yeh tumhara colour hai.

concept.caption: Closet felt empty, 8 days to go 🪔 Beige organza with thread work on the kurta and the sharara, light and lovely for the night puja. Then light blue georgette with an embellished yoke and gota on the pants for the morning. Undertone tips are just a starting point, not rules. Night look or morning look, which is more you?
concept.musicMood: Warm acoustic sitar and soft percussion, intimate and glowing, gentle build into the outfit change
